verdict.rationale: Bento is an AI-agent observability and improvement platform. Scheduled or recurring evaluations are a plausible capability for this kind of product, so the axis applies, but the evidence pack never documents a scheduler or recurring job feature. Real-time signal firing, history backfill and CI-run release scoring are adjacent features. Calling the CLI from a user's own scripts or CI would be a user-side workaround, not a native recurring schedule.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
